name: claude-mem
hook: 93.9k stars — persistent memory across every agent session using 5 lifecycle hooks, SQLite, and Chroma vector search. Captures what your agent does, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Grok Bot, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, and OpenCode.

name: img2threejs
hook: 16.1k stars — attach any reference image and Claude produces a THREE.Group factory in TypeScript that recreates the object from primitives and procedural shaders, no mesh files, no photogrammetry. An 8-stage quality-gated pipeline (blockout → structural → form → material → surface → lighting → interaction → optimization) with vision review at each step. Featured in Charlie Automates' '8 Insane GitHub Repos' video published September 14.

name: Messages API Compact-on-Demand
hook: Anthropic platform release September 14 — pass the beta header compact-2026-09-04 to trigger mid-session summarization without waiting for context overflow. The model generates a compaction block capturing task state, key decisions, and next steps, then continues the session on the trimmed context. Cuts per-task cost on long agentic API workloads.

name: NanoClaw
hook: 30.8k stars — lightweight, container-isolated alternative to OpenClaw that runs Claude agents in their own Linux containers with filesystem sandboxing, not merely permission checks. Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and Gmail via skill-added channels. Includes memory, scheduled recurring jobs, and runs directly on Anthropic's Agents SDK. Small enough to read and understand the whole codebase.

name: Distilly
hook: 24.8k stars — builds portable Person Profiles from materials you provide (Slack/WeChat/DingTalk exports, X posts, PDFs, emails) and packages each profile as an Agent Skill your coding agent can invoke. Covers colleagues, public figures, and historical personas with source-grounded decision patterns and expression analysis. Supports Claude Code, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, Pi, Grok Build, and OpenCode.
